row.notes: (png, info, where): libpng write_unknown_chunks: loops info unknown chunks +0x130 (count +0x138, stride 0x20) with location byte +0x18 & where, applies keep rules (list png+1000 count png+0x3e4, default png+0x3e0, safe-to-copy bit), warns 'Writing zero-length unknown chunk' (Ne_Libpng_Warning 0x1447a0590, not chunk data) and writes each via 0x1447a1690 (name, data, size). Callers Ne_Libpng_WriteInfo (call+jmp), Ne_Libpng_WriteEnd.
